reviews.behavior: State retained at DX8 edge and captured by native mesh/indexed paths, which reset the GL texture matrix before CPU coordinate emission. Pass-through, camera normal, camera position and reflection-vector modes exist. CPU row-matrix transformation handles count and projected flags, with a near-zero divisor guard. Output uses 2D coordinates; indexed UV selection picks UV1 only for source 1, otherwise UV0. Direct boundary also loads a GL texture matrix; route ownership and avoidance of double transformation require validation.
affected_scope: Native meshes and indexed submissions using original material mapper states; exact per-map materials and other draw routes remain open.
reviews.acceptance_open: Verify UV source domains, matrix/count/projected semantics, normals under scaling, divisor handling, cache invalidation and route ownership; compare Vita/PSTV environment/projected texture pixels.
